main.description: Register a CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM artifact with sbom.etzhayyim.com. Software SBOMs (cargo-cyclonedx output) and vehicle BOMs (kami-cad-import output, type=device per part) flow through the same SbomArtifact graph and CVE / recall pipeline (60-apps/etzhayyim-project-sbom/CLAUDE.md). For vehicle BOMs the optional vehicle* fields capture the part-graph metadata needed for Takata-style supplier recall queries.

format.description: Wire format. CycloneDX 1.5 is the default for both software and vehicle BOMs.

vehicleId.description: Stable vehicle id (e.g. mx5-na-1989). Present for vehicle BOMs only — software SBOMs leave this unset.

totalMassKg.description: Vehicle BOMs only — sum of effective_mass_kg across parts.

partCount.description: Vehicle BOMs only — number of CDX components.[type=device].

sourceUri.description: URI of the source artifact that produced this SBOM (e.g. scad://etzhayyim/roadster-na/v0.1.0, b2://drive/cad/...).

sourceSha256.description: SHA-256 hex of the source artifact. Used for deterministic SBOM serial number.

license.description: SPDX expression covering the source artifact (e.g. MIT, CC-BY-4.0, proprietary).

cdxJson.description: Full CycloneDX 1.5 (or SPDX 3.0) document, encoded as a JSON string. Validated server-side against the upstream schema.

artifactUri.description: AT URI of the SbomArtifact graph node (at://did:web:sbom.etzhayyim.com/com.etzhayyim.sbom.artifact/<rkey>).

componentCount.description: Number of CDX components ingested into the SbomComponent graph.

vulnMatchCount.description: Number of vulnerability matches detected synchronously against the existing CveEntry graph.

errors.name: DuplicateArtifact
errors.description: An artifact with the same sourceSha256 already exists.
